title: Bierprojekt
summary: A German-language survey research project analyzing beer and non-alcoholic beer consumption habits and preferences among consumers. Its data-generation pipeline uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata schema to produce synthetic survey records and SDV's evaluate_quality to assess them, running SDV as the core synthetic-data engine for the study.
